author: matsminex
quote:
An impressive world without the soul of GTA...

At first I kept wondering: is this Grand Theft Auto or Grand Domestic Simulator?

Rockstar has once again built a world that is technically impressive, no doubt about that. But along the way they seem to have forgotten what actually makes GTA feel like GTA.

GTA V stood out with bold characters, charisma, crazy dialogue and sharp satire. GTA VI, on the other hand, sometimes feels more like interactive couples therapy than the sequel to one of the most iconic games ever made. Jason comes across as an emotionless rock with no presence or personality. The characters lack the spontaneity and charisma of Michael, Franklin and Trevor, and previous iconic GTA characters (I played many games myself). The story also often gets lost in long, slow dialogue and everyday tasks that do little for the pacing. And all the while, you have to kiss Lucia's feet and keep her happy. 

At times Rockstar seems so afraid of being politically incorrect that the spontaneity, satire and unfiltered personality that made GTA so recognizable fade into the background. Earlier GTA games had character, humor and a strong identity you could recognize right away .

This is the most expensive game ever made, but money can't buy passion. It's the exact same pattern we saw with Rings of Power.

Rockstar may have built a bigger world, but that doesn't make it a better GTA.
